ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution covering approximately 95% of the visible surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips and central insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-tone pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters at the left and right distal tips. Sparse white circular mottling on the mid-left lobe and upper-right lobe. Linear white pixel aggregation along the central peduncle/notch axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern; left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks. Right lobe trailing edge displays more discrete, medium-amplitude notches including a prominent 'U' shaped indentation near the mid-section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a primary convex curve; leading edge shows a sharp upward sweep toward the tips resulting in a tapered, acute tip geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular high-intensity white pixels (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual white circular points on the left lobe mid-region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct near-parallel vertical white linear marks located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe; additional faint diagonal linear disruption on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified-intensity clusters at the terminal points of both lobes; multiple vertical linear scars on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast white ring-shaped mark on the upper right lobe near the trailing edge, isolated from other mottling.
